description: February 5 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 2, birthday number 5, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 5 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the second decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 5. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: Personality of a February 5 birthday
paragraphs: Five on the fifth of February: freedom, variety and movement in their purest numerological form. The Sun stands around sixteen degrees of Aquarius, a sign that already values independence, and Mercury sub-rules the decan. Interpreters describe a fast-moving, socially curious temperament that tends to collect experiences, languages and friends from many walks of life.

By noon UTC on February 5, the Sun has normally reached roughly 16° of Aquarius. That places the date in the Aquarius decan that astrologers give to Mercury, the second of three. Between 10 and 19 degrees of Aquarius the sub-ruler is Mercury, the ruler of Gemini. Birthdays from around January 30 to February 8 tend to bring a quick, communicative intelligence to the sign's idealism. Natives are often seen as witty, curious and well networked, the kind of person who knows someone in every group and enjoys connecting them. Writing, teaching and technical problem-solving are commonly associated with this decan. Mercury can make the mind race ahead of the body and the heart. Slowing down long enough to listen as well as explain usually deepens their many connections.

sections.heading: Numerology of the February 5 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 5th, your birthday number is 5, sitting at the exact midpoint of the single digits. Numerologists read the day of birth as a secondary note, a personal knack rather than a fixed fate. The 5 is linked with movement, the senses and curiosity, so a 5th birthday is traditionally associated with adaptability and a low tolerance for monotony. These people often learn fastest by doing and enjoy travel, variety and new company. Freedom matters to them, and so does choosing which commitments are worth the trade, since restlessness can otherwise scatter a great deal of energy.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same February 5 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: February 5 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 5 is the 36th day of the year. In most years Pisces season is under way by February 19, 14 days after this birthday.

February 5 is a date where the Chinese animal genuinely depends on the year. Lunar New Year had arrived by this date in 64 of 121 years between 1924 and 2044; in the others the birth belongs to the previous animal. February 5 is also the birthday of Neymar (1992), William S. Burroughs (1914) and Robert Peel (1788).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 5?
faq.answer: February 5 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 5?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 5 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 5 for everyone born on the 5th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 5?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology needs care here, because Lunar New Year moves between January 21 and February 20. Across 1924 to 2044 it had passed by February 5 in 64 of 121 years, so the year page for your birth year settles it.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 5?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a February 5 birthday are Neymar (1992), William S. Burroughs (1914) and Robert Peel (1788). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
